portfolio.name: Kitry Occupational Health and Safety Portfolio

products.name: Kitry Occupational Health
products.description: The core module of the Kitry platform and the system of record of an employer's internal or autonomous occupational health service. It keeps the workforce register synchronised from HR (workers, contracts, assignments, sites and workstations), derives the required examination type and periodicity per country and per exposure profile (night work, chemical, biological and physical exposures, safety-critical posts), plans convocations and appointments with SMS and e-mail reminders, runs the consultation day with pre-visit questionnaires and measurements captured from connected devices (audiometry, spirometry, vision, ECG, biometrics), records fitness-for-work opinions with restrictions and accommodations, manages vaccination and health-promotion campaigns, and maintains the complete, confidential occupational medical file (DMST in France, medical dossier in Belgium) with medical secrecy, access segregation, retention and transfer between services. Delivered in French, Dutch and English on HDS-certified hosting, with sector pre-configurations for industry, chemicals and pharma, healthcare facilities, universities and research, public sector, financial services, transport and logistics, and services. More than 4 million employee records are tracked on the platform.

products.name: Kitry Workplace Safety
products.description: The prevention module for HSE managers and prevention advisers. It maintains the risk assessment per workstation and site (DUERP in France, global prevention plan and annual action plan in Belgium) on the same workstations and exposure profiles the physician sees, receives hazardous situation reports from the field, schedules inspections, audits and compliance checks, drives corrective and preventive actions to closure with owners, deadlines and evidence, and keeps a chemical product inventory with safety data sheets, hazard classification, CMR tracking and exposure groups that feed medical surveillance. Provides the evidence structure for ISO 45001 management systems and comes pre-configured for the risk catalogues of industry, chemicals and pharma, healthcare facilities, universities, public sector, finance, transport and logistics, and services organisations.

products.name: Kitry Work Accidents and Occupational Diseases
products.description: The event module that takes a work accident, commuting accident or suspected occupational disease from first report to declaration, analysis and follow-up. It records the event with circumstances, injuries, witnesses and workstation context, pre-fills the country-specific national forms and connectors (French CERFA / Ameli declarations, Belgian Fedris and insurer declarations, Luxembourg and Dutch equivalents) so HR declares correctly and on time, runs root-cause analysis with the prevention adviser and the physician, computes frequency and severity rates and statistics per site and period, and follows absence, recognition and return-to-work together with the medical service. Events link back to the risk assessment so every accident becomes a prevention action.

products.name: Kitry Employee and Manager Portals
products.description: Role-based self-service portals that extend the platform to every employee and manager of the organisation. The employee portal lets workers book and reschedule their medical visits, complete pre-visit questionnaires privately, download certificates and fitness attestations, join secure teleconsultations and report a hazardous situation from any device. The manager portal shows site and line managers the fitness clearance and restrictions of their team without ever exposing medical content, lets them release workers for visits, follow corrective actions and initiate accident declarations. Responsive web design for use on the floor; SSO with the corporate identity provider. In Kitry's French, Belgian and Luxembourg customers more than half of employees use self-service features.

products.name: Kitry Monitoring, KPIs and Regulatory Reports
products.description: The transversal monitoring module that reads across occupational health, workplace safety and accident data. Dashboards and KPIs show surveillance coverage and periodicity compliance, medical capacity utilisation, questionnaire completion, hazardous situation and action closure, accident frequency and severity rates per site, business unit and period. Regulatory and annual reports are generated from the same data: the annual activity report of the occupational health service, the Belgian annual report of the internal prevention service, DUERP and prevention plan extracts, and social and safety indicators for the employer, the works council and the authorities. Collective health monitoring aggregates anonymised findings by exposure group for epidemiological follow-up and collective prevention advice.

products.name: Kitry Teleconsultation
products.description: Secure teleconsultation integrated into the consultation workspace and the employee portal and delivered through the Vonage video platform. The physician or nurse launches a video consultation from the convocation, the employee joins from the portal link on any device, the pre-visit questionnaire and prior measurements are at hand, and the fitness opinion, notes and documents are written directly into the occupational medical file. Sessions are encrypted and run under the same HDS and ISO 27001 controls as the file itself. Used for remote sites, follow-up visits, return-to-work interviews and for workers who cannot travel to the medical service.

products.name: Kitry Ecosystem Integrations
products.description: The connectivity layer that keeps the platform in sync with the customer's systems and the partner ecosystem: HRIS synchronisation and import of employees, contracts, assignments and organisation structures (scheduled files and APIs), SSO with the corporate identity provider, electronic signature of certificates and fitness attestations with Goodflag, SMS convocations and reminders with Cegedim, secure video with Vonage, and measurement device connectors for Eolys, FIM, Essilor, JLM Medical and Siemens audiometers, spirometers, vision testers and biometric devices, plus national reporting connectors for accident and occupational disease declarations. Configured during implementation and monitored by Kitry so surveillance is triggered automatically from HR events and screening results land in the file without re-keying.

products.name: Kitry SaaS Hosting (Shared and Dedicated HDS)
products.description: The hosting tier of every Kitry subscription. Shared HDS SaaS runs customers on multi-tenant HDS-certified (Hébergeur de Données de Santé) and ISO 27001-certified infrastructure with strict tenant isolation, encryption, audit trail and retention rules; Dedicated HDS SaaS provides a single-tenant environment for organisations that require their own instance, release window or network integration. Both tiers are hosted exclusively inside the European Economic Area with no access from outside the EEA, operated and monitored by Kitry with a standard release train under the 'Kitry as a Service' model, so an occupational health service runs on certified, secure infrastructure without an IT project of its own.

products.name: Kitry Implementation and Services
products.description: The services model that takes every customer live and keeps it current. Deployment follows four phases: functional assessment of the organisation's surveillance rules, sites and roles; configuration of forms, workflows, business rules and languages on the configuration engine, starting from sector pre-configurations for industry, chemicals and pharma, healthcare facilities, universities and research, public sector, financial services, transport and logistics, and services; project management with a named project lead; and training of physicians, nurses, HSE, HR and managers. Proven data migration brings decades of medical files and legacy safety data across from previous systems, and change management drives self-service adoption. After go-live, reactive support, regulatory and product release updates for France, Belgium, Luxembourg and the Netherlands, and a dedicated account manager per customer.
